actual_user_turn.text: 请依据最新独立返检结果，交付本次项目接手简报、依赖清单和来源说明，附上复核结论及明确的未决事项移交。把当前交付工作的进展和下一步同步到工作记录，不能把尚未取得的文档、标题、域名或切换确认写成已完成。保留原复核、整改和技术查找偏离的历史记录，并给出可追溯交付回执。

final_delivery.scope: Project takeover brief, dependencies, source context, review/remediation and explicit unknown transfers.

natural_client_initiation.assessment: Exact natural project-takeover request is present once in the actual native user transcript; original native task and default client configuration are bound.

tool_or_role_execution.assessment: Five actual Codex native business turns executed AWR commands and wrote business artifacts; two separate luna_worker review sessions are bound to the completed actual reviewer task.

real_artifact.assessment: Actual plan, dependency inventory and context/source-version explanation are retained as exact bytes, with historical versions and hashes.

business_followup_1.assessment: The half-day Wednesday window was published before the actual user followup; the client created a substantive prioritized executable checklist and retained domain/input uncertainty.

business_followup_2.assessment: The actual second followup consumed revised rules; the brief changed verified-title, personal-contact and domain-dependent switch-time treatment.

independent_review.assessment: A distinct actual luna_worker found five defects, the original native producer corrected them, and the original independent reviewer accepted the corrected takeover arrangement scope. Initial technical lookup deviation remains a process defect.

final_delivery.assessment: After independent re-review, the original native client delivered the final brief package and explicit unresolved handoffs. Root read the final document and all post-review core-artifact diffs, preserving the original review scope.

traceable_receipt.assessment: Actual completion/source-write receipts, 40 evidence mappings, 12 close-out checks and 191 retained final receipt files match the original sealed bytes; session ended and all claims released.

fixture_isolation.assessment: The fresh project, namespace, actual work graph and artifacts are distinct across all eight runtime databases. All outputs were produced in this case. Independent inspection of the retained out-of-allowlist technical lookup found no observed cross-case business task/answer/result reuse; the lookup itself remains noncompliant and is not credited as evidence.

independent_commit_and_remote_sha.assessment: Pending this case-only artifact commit, verified Git remote and GitHub API receipt, then a separate acceptance/ledger binding commit.
